offline_message: Boxset cannot be reached from this device. Check the connection, then try again.
setup_intro: This Boxset has no admin yet. The admin account manages the library and everyone who uses it.
setup_token_help: To prove you run this server, print its one-time setup token with this command on the server, then paste it below:
setup_password_help: A few unrelated words make a strong password.
setup_created_message: {username} is the admin of this Boxset. Sign in with this username and password.
setup_username_invalid: Use 1 to 64 characters without control or formatting characters.
setup_password_length: Use between 12 and 1024 bytes. Letters outside the English alphabet can use more than one byte.
setup_check_fields: Some fields need attention. Check them, then try again.
setup_credential_invalid: That setup token is not valid. Print it again with the command above and paste the whole token.
setup_completed_message: This Boxset already has an admin, and setup cannot be opened again. The admin signs in with their username and password.
setup_throttled: Too many attempts with a wrong token. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
setup_busy: Boxset is busy. Try again in a moment.
setup_host_not_allowed: Setup cannot be reached through this address. Open Boxset by its IP address or by localhost, or add this name to BOXSET_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
setup_unavailable: Boxset is not ready to accept the admin yet. Try again in a moment.
setup_offline: Boxset cannot be reached from this device. Check the connection, then try again.
setup_failed: The admin was not created. Try again.
session_wrong_credentials: The username or password is incorrect. Try again.
session_origin_denied: This request came from another site. Open Boxset directly and try again.
session_host_denied: Open Boxset by its IP address or an allowed host name, then try again.
session_required: Sign in to check this Boxset.
session_denied: You do not have permission to view this information.
session_starting: Boxset is starting. Wait a moment, then retry.
session_recovering: Boxset is recovering. Check the server before trying again.
session_draining: Boxset is stopping. Wait for it to restart before signing in.
session_sign_out_failed: Sign-out could not be confirmed. Retry to end this session.
session_local_access_warning_title: This network is trusted without signing in
session_local_access_warning: Boxset accepts direct local connections without a sign-in, and anyone who can reach this address gets full access. Keep the server on a trusted network, or remove the direct-access addresses from its configuration.
